about: Astro's displays on OxyOS (ADR 0029): Chromium's display list is the session's outputs (ApplicationOutput: size, scale, refresh, work area), its window's display the output it is on (SurfaceOutput), and its frames paced at that output's refresh (Refresh, Chromium's VSync interval). Run with the engine as `--client` on two outputs, the second 1920×1200 at 1.5 (1280×800 logical) paced at 120 Hz; the page (pages/astro-outputs.html) is Astro's tab, 190 px right of the window's edge and 47 px down. On the first output the page's screen is 1280×720 at 1 and its frames 16.7 ms apart; moved onto the second, its screen is 1280×800 at 1.5 and its frames 8.3 ms apart. The window's own size taken for the display, a screen that does not follow the window, or frames at 60 on the 120 Hz output fails it.

steps.name: a press on the page once Astro shows it: its screen is the first output, 1280×720 at 1, its frames at 60
the page measured its frames' pace on the first output
moved onto the second output: its screen is 1280×800 at 1.5 (the window at 260,160 there, drawn at 1.5)
and its frames come at the second output's 120 Hz
